description: BEFORE interacting with ANY smart contract, call this to get a full security report. Fetches source code (if verified), analyzes bytecode, detects vulnerabilities (reentrancy, hidden mint, backdoors, proxy risks, access control issues), and returns a risk score 0-100 with actionable findings. One call = complete analysis.
